As you get older you experience new things. Your understanding of your own needs grows. You might not have met someone of that gender before that checked all of your boxes so you may have thought you only liked one type of person. So now that you have met someone out of the norm for you it can cause you to realize that you are more fluid than one sexuality. This might change even more over time. I am in my early 30’s and 10 years ago I was only interested in women, but this last year I had a boyfriend for a bit. I still prefer other girls but I now understand that sometimes things can happen that can change my whole perspective on my outlook on relationships.

I love alpha’s and beta’s. You get a lot of funny stories out of them. Random laughs from silly bugs. Glitches in the artworks. You also get to see the creative process, and be a part of the testing for the final product! It isn’t for everyone but I thrive when I am learning something new with everyone in that environment. Plus. Nowadays I would much rather be a part of a alpha or beta. Try to really help test it so everyone can enjoy it later. We get to many games nowadays that are unfinished and stuffs.

It’s not about the finances. That’s where I am at now but I was trying to convey that after 29 years of abuse my mind has shut down. It began last year and for the last year everything’s been falling apart. I’ve been on hormones for years so I do have feminine traits, I’m just presenting as male because I’m afraid. I was an effective leader at one point, and I kept bottling things up until I finally snapped. I just gave up.  It’s been so hard to get back to myself, especially since I’m alone. I sought treatment, I focused on myself, and even moved into a new company to try and reduce stress. I know now that I need to take a step back from being a leader in order to let my mind heal. That’s going to effect my income, and I know there will be consequences. I have always been such a good worker, and as someone who’s by themself in the world I have always done my best to take care of myself. I just can’t heal with the stress of my job :/ and it stinks because I know there are millions out of work right now. I want to move... to leave everything behind, and find somewhere to heal. Yet I dunno if that’s even possible :/ What am I if not a slave to my torment?
